Name: APF - Animated Portrait Framework
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Animated Portrait Framework (APF)[/b][/size][/center]

[size=4]A SMAPI framework that brings Stardew Valley NPC portraits to life with frame-based sprite animations. APF supports unlimited expressions, multiple animation modes, automatic DDF integration, and memory-efficient per-expression spritesheets. Modders can create powerful JSON content packs without writing a single line of code.

[color=#ff0000][b]Requirements:[/b][/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7569][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+.[/size]

[size=4][b]Core Capabilities[/b][/size]
[list]
Unlimited Expressions: Break past the vanilla limit of six portraits and define as many custom expressions as you need.[/list][list]
Flexible Animation Modes: Configure frames to play in a loop, pingpong back and forth, play once, or play once and pingpong.[/list][list]
Native Conditional Variants: Set up dynamic outfits triggered by location, weather, season, or heart levels using built-in weighted randomizer logic.[/list][list]
Overworld Sprite Syncing: Automatically patches matching character sprites over the vanilla sheets at late load priority, retaining compatibility with mods that add custom animation frames.
[*] [b]Memory Efficient:[/b] Per-expression mode ensures only the active expression is loaded into VRAM, keeping performance smooth.[/*]
[/list]
[i]For a comprehensive, step-by-step tutorial on building an APF content pack, configuring JSON files, and managing variant rules, please refer to the detailed README located in the [b]Articles tab[/b].[/i]

[line]

[center][size=5][b]APF Portrait Studio (Alpha)[/b][/size][/center]

[size=4]APF Portrait Studio is a local, browser-based companion tool designed to make creating APF content packs effortless. It runs entirely on your machine via Flask, meaning no cloud uploads are required. It includes a built-in Tour Guide to walk you through the entire workflow.[/size]

[b]Studio Prerequisites: [/b]
[url=https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg]FFMPEG Full Build[/url]
[url=https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg]RemBG[/url]

[size=4][b]Studio Features[/b][/size]
[list]
Video to Sprite Conversion: Import short video clips (such as generated character animations) and slice them into perfectly timed sprite frames using the built-in cutter.[/list][list]
Automated Background Removal: Uses AI to strip backgrounds and create clean, transparent sprite sheets. (Black backgrounds are highly recommended for the best results).[/list][list]
Dialogue & Trigger Management: Visually assign dialogue lines to specific expressions and configure in-game conditions like weather, location, or heart levels.[/list][list]
DDF & Export Settings: Configure your Dialogue Display Framework offsets and scaling visually before exporting.[/list][list]
One-Click Export: Export your finished project directly to your Stardew Valley Mods folder, or download it as a ZIP for mod managers like Vortex.[/list][list]
Static Replacer Support: You can use the studio to create normal, non-animated portrait replacers by setting your input to 1 frame at 1 FPS.[/list]
